name: Nha Trang
provinceNote: Nha Trang is a city in Khánh Hòa. Resolution 202/2025/QH15 joins the former Ninh Thuận province into Khánh Hòa and keeps that name: 8,555.86 km² and 2,243,554 people. The new provincial government operates from 1 July 2025.
dotReason: Worth it if you are already nearby
summary: A beach city on the south-central coast, with a long city beach, a bay full of islands, and mud baths. Swim on the 7 km Tran Phu beach, boat out to snorkel and dive, visit the Cham towers of Po Nagar, and eat grilled pork rolls, clay-mould rice cakes, and seafood. Two days suits beach lovers and families.

seoTitle: Nha Trang travel guide — beach, islands, snorkel, mud baths
seoDescription: Swim the seven-kilometre Trần Phú beach, snorkel and dive at Hòn Mun, and soak in the mud baths. Po Nagar is about 2 km north. Dry months are January to August.
intro: You step onto the sand at Trần Phú, seven kilometres of city beach, the swim by day and the walk after dark. A boat from this shore is the snorkel and the dive at Hòn Mun, or a glass-bottom boat over the coral. The mud baths are the other half of the day: Tháp Bà, behind Po Nagar, is the oldest, with communal and private mud and mineral pools. Trăm Trứng and I-Resort are the other two, and I-Resort is the one named most popular. Yang Bay, inland, puts the mud bath on the top ticket, with the falls.

Po Nagar sits about 2 km north of the centre. The seated white Buddha is at Long Sơn, 22 đường 23 tháng 10. Nineteen islands fill the bay. Hòn Tre is the cable crossing, 3,320 m over the water. Hòn Mun is the swim shore. The night market is the 137 m street behind 46 Trần Phú.

Sleep on Trần Phú when the beach, the islands, and the seafood are the trip. The family stay on Hòn Tre is Vinpearl Resort and Spa Nha Trang Bay, and the cable is the crossing. Eat nem nướng and bún cá from Ninh Hòa, bánh căn from the clay mold, and the market bowls at Chợ Đầm and Chợ Xóm Mới.
gettingAround: From Cam Ranh, shuttles, taxis, and ride-hailing cover the ride in. Po Nagar is about 2 km north of the centre. The cable to Hòn Tre measures 3,320 m. It was inaugurated in March 2007 as the longest sea-crossing cable car in the world at that time, and it is also called the longest in Southeast Asia.

The railway puts Nha Trang at km 1315 from Hà Nội and km 411 from Sài Gòn. Southbound from Hà Nội the five trains run 24 hours 57 minutes to 28 hours 3 minutes. Southbound from Đà Nẵng is 9 hours 13 minutes to 11 hours. Northbound to Đà Nẵng is 9 hours 30 minutes to 11 hours 1 minute. Southbound to Sài Gòn is 7 hours 48 minutes to 10 hours 23 minutes. Northbound from Sài Gòn is 7 hours 16 minutes to 8 hours 43 minutes. Southbound from Tuy Hòa is 2 hours 4 minutes to 2 hours 44 minutes. Northbound to Tuy Hòa is 2 hours 6 minutes to 2 hours 19 minutes on the four trains that list a time. One northbound train does not list a Tuy Hòa time.

stayAreas.name: Trần Phú
stayAreas.summary: The city sand and the hotel row. The night market is behind 46 Trần Phú.

eat: Eat nem nướng and bún cá from Ninh Hòa, and the night-market stalls behind 46 Trần Phú. Bánh căn is the clay-mold rice cake, with squid, shrimp, or egg.

Chợ Đầm and Chợ Xóm Mới carry the market bowls, including gỏi cá mai and bánh canh cá dầm, plus the other Khánh Hòa dishes tied to a town. Vinpearl Harbour, the two Vincom plazas, and Nha Trang Center are the restaurant doors.
interestsBody: Use the city in this order. Swim or walk Trần Phú. Eat the Ninh Hòa dishes, then the market bowls. Cross to Hòn Tre or snorkel and dive at Hòn Mun. Climb to the Cham towers and the white Buddha if the day still has light. Soak in the mud when that is the reason for the afternoon.
The night is the sand and the walking street, not a second beach. The island stay for families is Vinpearl Resort and Spa Nha Trang Bay, on Hòn Tre.

blocks.heading: Chợ Đầm
paragraphs: Chợ Đầm stands at Bến Chợ, Vạn Thạnh. The hall is likened to a lotus, 66.5 m across and 5,270 m², able to hold more than 3,000 people. The site was a 7 ha lagoon, and the market was built up in 1908. Entry is free. Seafood is on one side. Bún cá, bún chả cá, and nem are on the other, with bánh tráng, muối ớt xanh, and mắm. It is busy every day.

blocks.heading: Chợ Xóm Mới
paragraphs: Chợ Xóm Mới is at 49 Ngô Gia Tự, built from the 1960s. Traders are given as more than 1,500, and seafood traders as more than 1,000. Entry is free. The dried counter sells mực một nắng, mực rim, cá khô, and cua rang muối. Fresh seafood is tôm, mực, cua, cá, ngao, sò, ốc, and hến. The bowls are bánh canh chả cá, bánh xèo, bún sứa, nem nướng, bún chả cá, bún cá, and bún canh.

blocks.heading: Trần Phú night market
paragraphs: The walking street behind 46 Trần Phú is 137 m, in Lộc Thọ, and free to enter. It holds 50 stalls, 16 of them food: bún chả, chả cá, bánh căn, fried squid, breaded shrimp, ice cream, and chè.

blocks.heading: Harbour Market
paragraphs: Harbour Market is the indoor market at Vinpearl Harbour, with more than 200 stalls of street food, local specialties, dried goods, and crafts.

interestGroups.title: The bay
interestGroups.summary: Nineteen islands. The cable is the way onto Hòn Tre. Hòn Mun is the snorkel and the dive.
body: Hòn Tre is the largest island, over 3,000 ha and also given as 3,323.15 ha. The cable is 3,320 m. You swim, snorkel, and jet-ski from the island, and Vinpearl Resort and Spa Nha Trang Bay is the family stay.

At Hòn Mun you snorkel or dive the coral, or ride a glass-bottom boat. About 350 coral species are named, more than 40% of the world’s hard corals. The water was planned as Vietnam’s first marine protected area, and Hòn Mun is also called the only protected marine reserve.

faqs.a: January to August is the dry season, and September to December is rainy. The bay averages 26°C. The 2025 sea cultural-tourism festival ran 7 June–9 July. Po Nagar’s annual festival is lunar 20–23 of month 3, and in 2026 the festival days were 6–11 May, lunar 19–25.
Cam Ranh is 27 km from the centre of Nha Trang, with the city to the north, and about 30 km south. Shuttles, taxis, and ride-hailing cover the ride in.
